map.Langefors 公式 Q = k·W³ 适用于岩体爆破初始药量估算: The Langefors formula Q = k·W³ suits initial charge estimation for rock blasting
map.装药长度 = Q / (π·r²·ρ)，ρ 为装药密度，r 为药卷半径（经验值）: Charge length = Q / (π·r²·ρ), where ρ is the charge density and r the cartridge radius (empirical value)
map.实际爆破需根据岩石性质、炸药类型及现场试验调整: Actual blasting must be adjusted for rock properties, explosive type and field trials
map.体积法：已知孔网（孔距、排距、孔深）与单位炸药消耗量 q，估算单孔药量、总药量与: Volume method: given the hole pattern (hole spacing, row spacing, hole depth) and the unit explosive consumption q, estimate the per-hole charge, total charge and blasted volume.
map.Langefors 法：已知最小抵抗线 W 与单位耗药量 k，按 Q=k·W³: Langefors method: given the minimum burden W and the unit charge consumption k, estimate the per-hole charge by Q=k·W³ (suits small-burden smooth blasting / pre-splitting).
map.反推装药长度与炮孔深度，校核装药结构是否超过填塞安全余量。: Back-calculate the charge length and hole depth, and check whether the charge structure exceeds the safe stemming margin.
map.体积法：体积 V=a·b·H，单孔药量 Q=q·V，总药量=Q×孔数；装药长度=: Volume method: volume V=a·b·H, per-hole charge Q=q·V, total charge=Q×number of holes; charge length=Q/(π·0.05²·1000) (linear density estimated on a 50 mm charge radius), hole depth≈H+0.3·W. Langefors method: Q=k·W³, volume≈W³/q.
map.q=0.45 kg/m³、a=3.0 m、b=2.5 m、H=10 m、孔数 2: q=0.45 kg/m³, a=3.0 m, b=2.5 m, H=10 m, 20 holes, W=2.5 m. Per-hole volume 75 m³, per-hole charge 33.75 kg, total charge 675 kg, charge length 4.30 m, hole depth 10.75 m.
Switch to the Langefors method, k=0.4, W=2.5 m: per-hole charge = 0.4×2.5³ = 6.25 kg, corresponding volume ≈ 2.5³/0.45 ≈ 34.7 m³. This method suits concentrated charges at small burden (W generally <3 m); for large burden switch to the volume method or split the charge.
map.q（单位炸药消耗量）怎么取？: How should q (unit explosive consumption) be chosen?
map.q 由岩石可爆性、孔径、自由面数等决定，可查爆破手册或按同类工程经验（如中硬岩台: q is determined by rock blastability, hole diameter, number of free faces and so on; consult a blasting handbook or use experience from comparable works (e.g. 0.4–0.5 kg/m³ for bench blasting in medium-hard rock). Here q is a user input and must be chosen for the actual conditions; a wrong value skews the total charge by multiples.
map.装药长度 4.30 m 是怎么算的？: How is the charge length of 4.30 m computed?
map.工具用 50 mm（半径 0.05 m）装药的线密度 π·0.05²·1000≈: The tool uses the linear density π·0.05²·1000≈7.854 kg/m of 50 mm (radius 0.05 m) charges to back-calculate: Q/7.854 = 33.75/7.854 ≈ 4.30 m. This is an approximation for a fixed 50 mm cartridge; with a different diameter or a decoupled charge, use the corresponding linear density.
